headline: Ajit Abraham Isaac and Isaac Enterprises LLP file substantial acquisition disclosure in Bluspring Enterprises
sum: Substantial acquisition of shares in Bluspring Enterprises Limited disclosed under SEBI Takeover Code Regulation 31(4). The acquirer entities filed a formal disclosure with the National Stock Exchange, triggering public shareholder notification obligations.
detail: Ajit Abraham Isaac and Isaac Enterprises LLP submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates public disclosure when an acquirer crosses key shareholding thresholds (typically 25% or more). The disclosure was filed on 19 June 2026. The specific acquisition quantum, consideration, and timing of open offer (if triggered) are contained in the regulatory filing but not detailed in the Bar & Bench summary.
